query:
One member first observed aloud that Callum was carrying more stress than usual and that his work had been difficult — framing it as something they had noticed but that Callum himself would not say in the chat. A different member in the same session agreed with this reading. Which member made the original observation about Callum's stress?

Options:
A. Omar
B. Jade
C. Temi
D. Lena
context:
[1] (about=Temi, episodic, t12 @2026-04-14T19:56:00) for what it's worth Callum's been carrying more than usual lately. work's been tough on him. I don't think he'd say that here but it was obvious at the reunion dinner when he relaxed around nine and actually seemed to enjoy it. he needed that evening.
[2] (about=Omar, episodic, t12 @2026-04-14T19:59:00) yeah temi's rite bruv callum doesnt say much but you can tell. glad he came
[3] (about=Callum, said_by=Temi, profile, t12 @2026-04-14T19:45:00) Temi notes Callum has been carrying more than usual lately, work's been tough on him, and he needed the reunion dinner evening
[4] (about=Callum, said_by=Omar, profile, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) Omar notes Callum left the pub night at around 9:30 as usual, implying a recurring early departure pattern.
[5] (about=Dev, episodic, t12 @2026-04-14T19:53:00) callum just voluntarily considered something new. checks notes, this is growth
[6] (about=Jade, core, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) Jade says nobody is worried about the nine o'clock cutoff except Callum, and thinks the documentary idea is good.
[7] (about=Omar, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T21:04:00) callum staying past 9 is officially the comeback story of 2026 😂😂
agent_answer: C. Temi — Temi made the original observation that Callum was carrying more than usual and that work had been tough on him. Omar then agreed with Temi’s reading.
